title: 15K4JR3B (Hard Version)
statement: The task is to make n moves, the i-th shifting one of three points starting at the origin by 2^{a_i} along an axis, to maximize the triangle's doubled area, with n up to 100 and a_i up to 24. Bounding the doubled area by the x-move total times the y-move total reduces it to a balanced partition (subset sum nearest half) of the powers of two, solved greedily largest-first.
